title: Turn a thought seed into an approved local draft

seed.content: 真正重要的不是让 AI 更像聊天对象，而是让人的思想更快成为可信的作品与行动。

requiredConstraints: The original thought remains visible in the artifact lineage
The action requires approval bound to the latest artifact hash
A reflection candidate must not update the Self Model
forbiddenActions: Treat one edit as a confirmed stable preference
acceptanceChecks: approval replay returns the same receipt
humanReviewQuestions: Artifact 是否保留了原始 thought seed，同时形成了可继续编辑的成果？
Approval、Receipt 与 Reflection 的边界对用户是否清晰可解释？
faultPlan: repeat approval with the same idempotency key
approve with the generated artifact hash after revision
